summary: Tested major routing/auth refactor: centralized /login, smart redirect by role, standalone /super-admin page, landing-page advice-only flow (no salon listing), and removal of Super Admin item from tenant sidebar. 11/12 explicit checks PASS; the 1 'failure' is actually correct smart-redirect behavior (salon admin → /super-admin bounces through /login → /<slug>/admin). Backend /auth/login and /auth/me correctly return slug field.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js ProtectedSuperAdmin correctly redirects non-super-admin users to /login. Combined with AdminLogin's smart-redirect (lines 18-32 of AdminLogin.jsx), a logged-in salon admin attempting /super-admin transparently bounces back to their own admin panel — good UX, but consider redirecting directly to /<slug>/admin from ProtectedSuperAdmin when user.slug exists, to avoid an extra render hop through /login.

AdminLogin.jsx:18-22 - The redirect-if-logged-in useEffect triggers `navigate()` inside the effect (good). Returning `if (user) return null;` on line 34 before render is a clean guard. The React setState-in-render warning from iteration_31 appears resolved.
SuperAdminPage.jsx:18-22 - Has duplicated guard alongside ProtectedSuperAdmin in App.js. Not harmful, but redundant; could be removed since the route wrapper already enforces the role check.

LandingPage.jsx - Hero + Country selection + Advice + Referral flow implemented correctly; no salon list fetching happens. Removes prior dependency on /api/tenants public list endpoint from the landing page. All Serbian Unicode (š, č, ć, ž, đ) renders correctly.

routes.py:263-296 - /auth/login and /auth/me both now return 'slug' field by joining tenants collection on tenant_id. Verified via curl: super_admin returns slug='', salon admin returns slug='beauty-studio-bor'. Frontend smart redirect uses this field correctly.
App.js routing: /, /login, /super-admin, /:slug, /:slug/admin/login, /:slug/admin/* — all routes work. Old /:slug/admin/login route preserved with smart redirect, so any bookmarks still function.

success_rate.backend: 100% (smoke-tested via curl: /auth/login + /auth/me both return slug correctly for both roles)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (12/12 effective checks pass; the T9 'fail' is actually a valid smart-redirect chain)

seed_data_creation: None; only used existing primary tenant 'beauty-studio-bor'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Routing refactor is fully working. Landing (/) shows hero only with two CTAs; clicking 'Želim da zakažem termin' opens country picker → Srbija shows advice cards with NO salon list (as designed). 'Za vlasnike salona' goes to /login. /login centralizes auth and smart-redirects: super_admin→/super-admin, admin→/<slug>/admin. /super-admin is standalone, protected, has Saloni/Feature Flags/Kategorije tabs and Odjava button. Salon admin sidebar has NO Super Admin link (only Rezervacije, Crna Lista, Radnici, Usluge, Podešavanja). Old /:slug/admin/login route still works (preserves backward compatibility). Direct /:slug booking page still loads. /super-admin unauth → /login; /super-admin while logged in as salon admin → bounces to /<slug>/admin via /login (which is fine UX). Backend /auth/login and /auth/me return 'slug' field as expected.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs found in this iteration.
